ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0 — QR detector, WASM execution provider.

The production page loads ort.wasm.js. Its matching runtime consists of
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs and ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm. Alternative
WebGPU/WebGL/Node/JSEP builds and source-map files are not needed here.

Project: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web/v/1.22.0
License: MIT, see LICENSE.txt.
